failures.title: Ensure /tmp is a separate partition
failures.rationale: Making /tmp its own file system allows an administrator to set additional mount options such as the noexec option on the mount, making /tmp useless for an attacker to install executable code. It would also prevent an attacker from establishing a hard link to a system setuid program and wait for it to be updated. failures.remediation: First ensure that systemd is correctly configured to ensure that /tmp will be mounted at boot time. # systemctl unmask tmp.mount For specific configuration requirements of the /tmp mount for your environment, modify /etc/fstab. failures.title: Ensure systemd-journal-remote is installed
failures.rationale: Storing log data on a remote host protects log integrity from local attacks. If an attacker gains root access on the local system, they could tamper with or remove log data that is stored on the local system.
failures.remediation: Run the following command to install systemd-journal-remote: # apt install systemd-journal-remote.

cis_ubuntu22-04.profile: CIS Ubuntu 22.04 Level 1 Server (Refresquito OneKE node image)

outOfScope.reason: Level 2 of the benchmark; the node image applies Level 1 Server only

notApplicable.reason: ufw is the firewall of the image (CIS 4.1); CIS asks to configure one utility only, so the nftables (4.2) and iptables (4.3) checks do not apply
the time daemon of the image is systemd-timesyncd (CIS 2.3.2); the chrony checks (2.3.3) do not apply
one root filesystem (the separate partitions are Level 2); the mount options of /home, /var, /var/tmp, /var/log and /var/log/audit apply only when the partition exists

accepted.title: ufw default deny firewall policy
accepted.reason: Outgoing traffic is allowed: the nodes talk to the API server, etcd, VXLAN, registries, S3, DNS and OneGate on many ports, and a port list breaks the cluster (register: 4.1.4). Incoming is denied by default and routed traffic only allowed for the pod and service CIDRs.
accepted.compensating: Egress controlled by the zone router and the Calico egress policies of each segment
